name: SPR_SpectrumAnalysis
summary: Reads a folder of surface plasmon resonance spectra and returns the numbers you actually compare between samples: peak intensity, full width at half maximum, resonance wavelength and a stability index, with the baseline already subtracted.
detail: Written for the nanoparticle work, where the position and width of the plasmon band say whether a colloid held together or aggregated. One command per measurement folder, one output folder per file.
people: Francisca Salas-Sepúlveda, Horacio Poblete, Sergio D. Garcia Schejtman, Juan D. Figueroa

name: pharmaco-suite
summary: A command-line toolkit for 3D pharmacophore modelling and de novo molecular design, built on the idea that a pharmacophore is only as good as the evidence behind it.
detail: It derives three independent models of the same binding site, from the crystal contacts, from the ligands and from the receptor residues, and merges them into a weighted consensus, so every feature carries a record of how many lines of evidence support it. A second module grows new candidate molecules with a genetic algorithm over SELFIES, scored against that pharmacophore and filtered by ADMET and chemical diversity, and writes them out ready for docking.
